analysis_kind: Offline analysis of existing user-operated original-client capture; ordinary local decoder evidence.
source_line_definition: 1-based lines in unmodified sky-decoded.jsonl; directions emitted separately.
rps_asset_scope: Unchanged 10302 main-role balances do not establish unchanged deferred move_to=2 run income. RPS hand/result labels remain unverified.
sanitization: All selected 206xx, battle and reward fields are retained except recursively omitted role/account/server-owner identity fields. Hero and guard instance IDs, names from game templates, actions, HP and reward values remain unchanged.
limitations: Question/option text is reconstructed from retained client tables, not historical UI screenshots; some NPC reply themes differ and are retained verbatim.
Both defeated fights included a skip request; natural round counts are not inferred from partial action headers.
Base hp, now_hp and battle hp_max are distinct observed values; no normalized percentage is substituted.
RPS ret=2 is not assigned an unverified win/tie/loss or hand label; main ledger balances do not settle deferred run rewards.
Four pairs of identical 20606 messages are retained without counting each copy as a separate payout or summing them as net income.
No before/after idle-income-page screenshots or round-reset boundary were captured; no request alone cannot determine pure-client UI navigation.
Read-only screenshot search covered only common current-day filename formats in two standard directories.
Receiver closure and a clean decode do not prove lossless network observation.
